blocks.title: Nostalgic Completionist
blocks.tagline: Console app that queues random unfinished TMX tracks for TrackMania Nations ESWC, Sunrise and Original.

items.title: Two modes
items.text: Finish unfinished tracks, or beat unbeaten author times; it skips on a saved replay.

items.title: Batches from TMX
items.text: Downloads a batch of random tracks and pushes them to the track list of a LAN server.

items.title: Replay copies
items.text: Accepted replays are copied to a folder per session for upload.

items.title: Ban list
items.text: A ban file per game excludes tracks for good.

blocks.title: Notes
blocks.markdown:
The app connects to the running game through GBXRemote and detects finishes by watching the replay folder. It does not support Stunts, Platform or multilap tracks. For ESWC the game must be started before the app.

It was made for the 100% TMX project and is a fork of the project of the same name by BigBang1112.

blocks.title: Credits
